purpose: One place that says whether two years of a measure can be compared. The dashboard's comparability indicators, the suppressed change figures, the colour-scale segments and the continuity columns in downloads all read this file. Having a value for every year does not make a valid trend: a change can come from how the data was collected, defined or mapped rather than from what happened.

availability.reason: The selected 2011-2013 source tables supply no comparable Special and Local Laws or crimes-against-women aggregates, so they are left blank, not zero.
The 2016 extract supplies theft and robbery only. Its burglary figure combines criminal trespass and burglary, and its other aggregates use incompatible source definitions, so they are left blank.

definitionBreaks.reason: NCRB changed its reporting format and offence groupings in 2014, after the 2013 criminal-law changes. 2014 counts are not on the same basis as 2013, and the old burglary head and the revised criminal-trespass/burglary head are different measures.
2016 comes from a different compilation (the India Data Portal extract of NCRB data) than the 2011-2015 NCRB tables.
Burglary up to 2015 is the revised criminal-trespass/burglary head; from 2017 it is the day-plus-night burglary definition.
2016-2021 come from the India Data Portal extract and 2022 onward from NCRB's own district-wise tables.
The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita replaced the Indian Penal Code on 1 July 2024, so the 2024 tables use BNS numbering and offence groupings follow the source table.

epochs.reason: The same 11 district names are used, but no station-by-station roster exists for these years (the December 2014 roster is the only dated one), so a station moving between districts cannot be ruled out.

breaks.reason: Delhi Police districts were reorganised. Rohini and Shahdara were notified on 14 October 2016 and reported as newly created in early December 2016, and Dwarka followed on 9 November 2017. 48 of the 161 stations with archived shapes sit in a different district in the November 2017 schedule than in the December 2014 roster.
breaks.unaffectedNote: These four have the same station list in the December 2014 roster and the November 2017 schedule.

breaks.reason: Outer North was created on 1 January 2019 from parts of Rohini, North-West and Outer.
breaks.othersReason: Other station reassignments around 2019 are not documented.

roadDistrict.reason2022: The 2022 road-death and hit-and-run figures use the Traffic Police's 11 reporting districts, not the 15 police districts, so they cannot be compared with 2023 or 2024.
roadDistrict.cautionReason: The 2023 and 2024 crash-prone zone lists come from separate reports and list different zones; a change in the number of zones is not a change in risk.

reasons: Counts, not rates: traffic and population changed over the period.
Injury and simple/non-injury figures differ by source edition and are excluded.
The early reports' standardized 30-day fatality definition could not be confirmed.
The 2023 and 2024 lists come from separate reports and list different zones; a change in the number of zones is not a change in risk.
Year-to-date series (for example iRAD 2026) cover part of a year and are never compared with full years.
